name: bop-erp-web
description: BOP Nutraceuticals ERP - TypeScript rewrite (server + web client) over the existing SQLite Cloud database

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,client -c blue,magenta "npm -w @bop-erp/server run dev" "npm -w @bop-erp/client run dev"
scripts.build: npm -w @bop-erp/server run build && npm -w @bop-erp/client run build
scripts.typecheck: npm -w @bop-erp/server run typecheck && npm -w @bop-erp/client run typecheck && npm run typecheck:e2e
